content: Me titiŋ kadakahidok nadifo tilak adi yadi nadinadinit mokit
Me saŋiniŋnit, du datok nadiune loune Bepaŋ’walaŋ metamŋiyedok titiŋ kadakaniŋ tiyemguŋ wendok-kube mede wapum toŋa ya-nadifolaŋ? Adi yadi Bepaŋdi helemahelemaŋ siloŋ tobogoŋ tiyemiŋa yabudokolak.
Du adi yalaŋ-me, medege adi tahak mikit hinekdi me niŋ dobulaŋ nabugoŋ. Helemahelemaŋ adi metam noli yehitubu-kadakadok hogok nadilaŋ.
Du adi titiŋ momooŋdok mu nadiŋa titiŋ hogolidok hogok nadilaŋ. Tiŋa undugoŋ mede biyagoŋ yodok mu nadiŋa mede yalaŋ yodok hogok nadilaŋ.
Du adi yalaŋ-me hinek, unduŋ doktiŋa me yehitubu-kadaka titiŋdok mede hogok yodok nadilaŋ.
Unduŋ doktiŋa Bepaŋdi gehitubu-kadakadapmaŋ tibaak. Tiŋa iit hatihatige gineniŋ gehitamabeemkulune waaŋ. Unduŋ tiŋa gehitubu-liwedapmaune du kwetfoloŋ kotigoŋ tuwot mu hatibaaŋ.
Me didimehidi du’walaŋkade nemek u mintaune kaŋ munta tineeŋ. Tiŋa gabugegeeŋ indiŋ yoneeŋ,
“I kaneŋ, me i Bepaŋdi tubulodaaŋ saŋiniŋ mu mimiŋdok nadiguk. Adi yadi nadisuŋiŋ fafaŋeniŋ adi muneeŋ bomboŋ gineŋ hakuk, tiŋa titiŋ hogolidi tubulodaune kedem hatidok unduŋ nadiguk.”
Iŋgoŋ nu adi undiniŋ mooŋ. Nu yadi bem olif nabugoŋ Bepaŋ yolineŋ yali duhuduhunit tilat. Nu Bepaŋdi helemahelemaŋ weleŋdi hinek nabukahile tilak u agaŋ nadisukilitilat.
Bepaŋ, du helemahelemaŋ nehitubu-lodalaŋ doktiŋa nu du ganiutumbaluwaat, dapmadapmaŋnit mokit. Tiŋa metamgeye namandahik foloŋ wohoge ganintilooŋ indiŋ yobit, “Bepaŋ adi titiŋ momooŋ hinek tilak.”
